reviewSamples.author: Photo of Melissa Rodriguez
reviewSamples.text: If you want a professional photographer with great quality photos then this is the place to go! I’ve done my sons first whole year photos with Yorka and she is absolutely the best! She’s great with the kids and very patient with them. I would highly recommend her! Looking forward to many more years with her ❤️
